title: Control Plane Policing: The Complete Beginner's Guide

scenes.narration: Think of a bouncer at the VIP door. If everyone rushes in, the party stops. Control plane policing limits the rush to the router's brain.

lines.t: A bouncer at the VIP door

scenes.heading: The VIP bouncer
scenes.narration: CoPP protects the router's processor. A class map picks out which traffic counts. A policy map says how fast it may arrive. You attach it under the control plane with service policy input. It only affects traffic sent to the router itself.

scenes.heading: Common mix-ups
scenes.narration: Three traps. It only handles traffic to the router. You have to configure it. The rate is in bits per second.

items.wrong: Rate is in packets per second

scenes.heading: Remember this
scenes.narration: So, to recap. CoPP protects the router's processor. It uses class and policy maps. It isn't on by default. Ready to practise? Try the Courseiva CoPP lab.
